description: Returns full details and affected-device samples for a specific crash group.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

device_page.description: One-based affected-device result page; defaults to 1.

device_page_size.description: Maximum affected-device samples to return; defaults to 25 and is capped at 100.

hash.description: Crash group hash returned by get_crashes or list_issues.

name: get_crash_details

data.description: Tool-specific result data, present when ok is true.

error.description: Error details, present when ok is false.

hint.description: Optional recovery guidance that does not expose credentials.

ok.description: True on success and false on failure.

pagination.description: Pagination state for retrieving more results.

title: Get Crash Details
